title: Containment Decision
description: A bounded structural decision describing a recommended or authorized response to an assessed structural pattern. A containment decision records what should be done and under what constraints; it does not assert that the response was executed or successful.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this containment decision.

pattern_ref.description: Reference to the structural pattern that gave rise to this decision.

decision.description: High-level bounded decision selected in response to the referenced pattern.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable reasons supporting the decision. These codes identify justification without replacing the underlying evidence or assessment.

rationale.description: Optional human-readable explanation of why the decision was selected.

confidence.description: Confidence in the appropriateness of this decision, expressed from 0 to 1. Confidence does not establish malicious intent or attribution.

constraints.description: Boundaries that must be respected if the requested response is executed.

alternatives.description: Alternative responses considered but not selected.

expires_at.description: Optional time after which this decision should no longer be treated as current without reassessment.

extensions.description: Domain-specific extension data. Extensions must not redefine the semantics of canonical fields.

action.description: Requested response operation. Domain analyzers may use a controlled vocabulary appropriate to their environment.

target_ref.description: Reference to the actor, resource, scope, or other structural target of the requested response.

scope.description: Structural scope over which the response is requested.

priority.description: Relative priority assigned to the requested response.

mode.description: Authority under which the response may proceed.

authorization_required.description: Whether additional authorization is required before execution.

authorization_ref.description: Optional reference to the policy, consent record, approval, or other authority governing execution.

class.description: Expected reversibility of the requested intervention.

rollback_available.description: Whether a known rollback mechanism is available.

rollback_ref.description: Optional reference to a rollback procedure, recovery object, snapshot, or equivalent mechanism.

platform.description: Platform or execution environment relevant to the requested response.

capabilities_ref.description: Reference to the applicable tf.platform-capabilities declaration.

capability_required.description: Capabilities required to execute the requested response as intended.

fallback_allowed.description: Whether an adapter may execute a weaker supported response when the requested capability is unavailable.

value.description: Constraint value. Interpretation is defined by the consuming domain or adapter.

producer.description: Analyzer, policy engine, human operator, or orchestration component that produced the decision.

assessment_ref.description: Optional reference to the assessment or analytical state from which the decision was derived.

source_refs.description: References to supporting lineage objects used in producing the decision.
